{{Quote|The barbarians are swarming&mdash;order the ''Wave gunners'' to hit them hard!|Iziz trooper, during the Battle of Iziz|<ref name="TotJ2">[[Tales of the Jedi 2|''Tales of the Jedi'' 2]]</ref>}}
[[File:WaveGunner.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Wave gunners firing at Beast Riders.]]
A '''Wave gunner''' was a type of [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] in the [[Naddist]] [[Naddist army|army]], which, in the year [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], was under the command of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Amanoa]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. These gunners were stationed in [[Iziz defense tower|Defense tower]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle stations]] that lined the walls of Onderon's capital city of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]]. Also in 4,000 BBY, during the [[Battle of Iziz|Battle for Iziz]], the Wave gunners, under the [[Callsign/Legends|call signs]] '''''Gunner 1''''' and '''''Gunner 4''''', were commanded by Amanoa to fire their complements of [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] and [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] at the oncoming force of [[Beast Riders]].
